player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I only recorded edges when I moved *into* a room, missing the return edges (e.g., the path from Billiard room back to Recreation room). I also stopped too early without verifying if all reachable rooms were visited. Next time, I will update the graph with bidirectional edges immediately upon entering a new room (adding the edge to the previous room) and continue exploring until the set of visited nodes equals the set of all discovered nodes, ensuring no unvisited neighbors remain before sending "DONE".
